notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Exciting news! 

Don't Drop the Bass will be released on March 17! 

It will include a new game mode (the previous slap VS with a new twist), as well as unlockable hats and "basses", achievements and other small changes.

The Bass Olympics shall soon begin! 🎏


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25379142/5fabc2279f8fbe5a426637b4639d1b5b7d0c2b43.png[/img]

notes.title: Updates and Final Release list of features
notes.notes:
Hi! Long time no see!
We just wanted you to know we're bringing these new features for the final release of Don't Drop the Bass in early 2017:

[list]
[*]New slapping mechanic: now players can slap forward and backward
[*]Global Leaderboards through Steamworks
[*]An improved third mode (Slap Vs) that involve player areas
[*]Unlockables:
[list] 
[*]Hats!
[*]Other fish to slap (Amongst other surprises)
[/list]
[*]Achievements
[*]Mac support
[/list]

We are releasing the improved new mode and slapping mechanics for you to try out over the next week! Please try it out and provide us some feedback so we can continue to improve this game c:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25379142/9ded9feebcd6a2e1cfe5541baeeef91b679f0f1f.jpg[/img]

Thank you! ːsteamhappyː

Felipe out.
